$comment: Shared constants for Shopify Admin REST actions (data-only; Pipedream-style common/). default_api_version 2026-10 is the current stable Admin API version (stable until at least 2027-10-01). 2024-01 is outside the supported window 2026-01 through 2026-10; Shopify falls forward when an unsupported version is sent. 2026-10 removes GraphQL PriceRule types and DraftOrderDiscountNotAppliedWarning.priceRule (use discountTitle and discountCode). These REST actions do not query those fields.
